mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_table ( task_name, priority_id, category_id, scheduled_work_date, parent_id, memo, done_flg ) VALUES ( #{taskName}, #{priorityId}, #{categoryId}, #{scheduledWorkDate}, #{parentId}, #{memo}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE item_table SET task_name = #{taskName}, priority_id = #{priorityId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, scheduled_work_date = #{scheduledWorkDate}, memo = #{memo}, done_flg = #{doneFlg} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
